instruction: Which banking customer-support intent does this customer message express? Choose the single best label.
order: alternating per example: even index Jev first, odd index LLM first

catalog_price_per_million.note: billed through Vercel AI Gateway at promotional $0 until 2026-09-25; the gateway also reports marketCost per call

llm.system: You classify customer messages sent to a bank's support team. Pick exactly one intent label from the allowed values. Reply with JSON only.

price_per_million.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4-mini (confirmed in docs/research/SOURCE_REFRESH_2026-09-24.md; Vercel AI Gateway lists the same price)
